pages.title: Heart and Claw
pages.text: The heart sustains the potions' power, lending force to close combat. Joined with the claw charm, it also grants faster claw strikes and greater reach in human form.

pages.title: Combined Effects
pages.text: Melee damage increases by 15%% in either form, not 25%%. In human form, it combines the Wild Pendant's faster claws and shorter tail-sweep cooldown with Rending Claw's wider ordinary claw attacks. It uses one accessory slot and cannot be worn with either component.
